gold_insights.insight: Area median income establishes the baseline for calculating income limits.
Tiers set thresholds at thirty, fifty, or eighty percent of base income.
Eligibility depends on US citizenship, eligible non-limit status, and AMI.
Income tiers are defined by percentages of Area Median Income (AMI).
Uses 2023 American Community Survey median family income data as primary basis.
Sets eligibility thresholds at fifty, eighty, and thirty percent of area medians.
